function determine_nic_type(str) {
  return str.match(/Ethernet/)
    ? "Wired"
    : str.match(/Wi-?Fi|AirPort/i)
    ? "Wireless"
    : str.match(/FireWire/)
    ? "FireWire"
    : str.match(/Thunderbolt/)
    ? "Thunderbolt"
    : str.match(/Bluetooth/)
    ? "Bluetooth"
    : str.match(/USB 10\/100\/1000 LAN/)
    ? "USB Ethernet Adapter"
    : "Other";
}
